page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.32xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 6462C processors with a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This server does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high vCPU count and 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is designed for compute-intensive workloads. It is suitable for high-performance computing, batch processing, intensive web serving, and distributed analytics where raw CPU performance and high network throughput are prioritized over large memory footprints or local storage.
